Theme: Build anticipation. Establish the mood without giving away the song.
Goal: Prime the algorithm, grow pre-release awareness, tease the visual identity.
Weekly priorities
Cover art reveal Mood / teaser content Release date announcement Sound clip tease

"4.3.26"

Behind-the-scenes photo or moody solo shot. Same lighting as cover art. Single line overlay.
"something's coming."

15-sec clip of the pre-chorus over a slow pan of the cover art or low-light video. No lyrics shown.
"No Attachments. April 3rd. @saintjordvn"

Story — countdown sticker
IG native countdown sticker. Cover art as background. Drives notification opt-ins.
"tomorrow."

30-sec get-ready or night-out video. Song playing in background. Text: "midnight."
